topic: switch-cube recall on the sister TF 250-X
statement: On the 2024-2025 TF 250-X, brake fluid could crack the right-hand plastic switch cube and short it so the bike started by itself; about 690 bikes were recalled for a free switch-cube replacement. The 2026 TF 250-C is not named in the recall, but owners should keep brake fluid off the switchgear.
notes: Applies to the 250-X; recorded here as platform history for the 250-C.

source.name: US CPSC recall 25-144: Triumph TF250-X off-road motorcycles (right-hand switch cube)

statement: Triumph's handbook says the MIL lights at key-on as a check but must not stay lit with the engine running; riding or racing with it on is not allowed because the fault can affect performance, and it must be checked by a trained technician. With the engine idling, turning the bars lock to lock must not change engine speed; if it does, check throttle cable routing and free play.

vals.mil: on at key-on only; lit while running = fault, stop riding
vals.throttle_check: idle must not change at full lock; else check cable routing and 2-3 mm free play
